+```python
+import numpy as np, pandas as pd
+from scipy import stats
+from statsmodels.nonparametric.smoothers_lowess import lowess
+from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
+
+m = pd.read_csv('data/Cervical_Spinal_Cord_metadata.tsv.gz', sep='\t')
+c = pd.read_csv('data/Cervical_Spinal_Cord_gene_counts.tsv.gz', sep='\t')
+ids = [x for x in c.columns[2:] if x in set(m.rna_id)]
+m = m.set_index('rna_id').loc[ids].reset_index()
+c = c.set_index(['ensembl_id', 'gene_name'])[ids]
+m['ALS'] = (m.disease == 'ALS').astype(float)
+m['male'] = (m.sex == 'Male').astype(float)
+X = pd.DataFrame({
+    'i': 1., 'ALS': m.ALS, 'age': m.age_rounded, 'male': m.male,
+    'RIN': m.rin, 'rib': m.pct_ribosomal_bases,
+    'usable': m.pct_usable_bases, 'bias3': m.median_3prime_bias,
+    'manual': (m.library_prep == 'Manual KAPA Total').astype(float)
+})
+X = pd.concat([
+    X,
+    pd.get_dummies(m.site_id, prefix='site', drop_first=True, dtype=float),
+    m[['gPC1', 'gPC2', 'gPC3', 'gPC4', 'gPC5']]
+], axis=1).astype(float)
+a = X.to_numpy()
+assert np.linalg.matrix_rank(a) == a.shape[1]
+
+y = c.to_numpy(float)
+lib = y.sum(0)
+cpm = y / lib * 1e6
+keep = (y >= 10).sum(1) >= 20
+z = np.log2(cpm[keep] + .5)
+pinv = np.linalg.pinv(a)
+b0 = pinv @ z.T
+e = (z.T - a @ b0).T
+df = len(ids) - a.shape[1]
+av = z.mean(1)
+s2 = (e * e).sum(1) / df
+
+# Estimate the mean--variance trend and evaluate it at each fitted
+# gene-by-sample log-CPM, producing genuine observation-level weights.
+lo = lowess(np.log2(s2), av, frac=.3, it=2, return_sorted=True)
+grid, logsd = lo[:, 0], lo[:, 1] / 2
+fit0 = (a @ b0).T                 # genes x samples
+trend_logsd = np.interp(
+    fit0, grid, logsd, left=logsd[0], right=logsd[-1]
+)
+W = 2 ** (-2 * trend_logsd)       # genes x samples
+
+q = np.einsum('ni,gn,nj->gij', a, W, a)
+qi = np.linalg.inv(q)
+coef = np.einsum('gij,nj,gn->gi', qi, a, W * z)
+e = z - np.einsum('ni,gi->gn', a, coef)
+gene_var = (W * e * e).sum(1) / df
+prior = np.median(gene_var)
+post = (4 * prior + df * gene_var) / (df + 4)
+se = np.sqrt(post * qi[:, 1, 1])
+t = coef[:, 1] / se
+p = 2 * stats.t.sf(abs(t), df + 4)
+fdr = multipletests(p, method='fdr_bh')[1]
+result = pd.DataFrame({
+    'ensembl_id': c.index.get_level_values(0)[keep],
+    'gene_name': c.index.get_level_values(1)[keep],
+    'log2FC': coef[:, 1], 'p': p, 'FDR': fdr
+})
+result.to_csv('de_results_voom.csv', index=False)
+sig = result[fdr < .05]
+
+# Exact artifact checks: counts, directions, top-gene statistics, and
+# observation-level weighting must all agree with the reported rerun.
+assert np.isfinite(result[['log2FC', 'p', 'FDR']]).all().all()

+assert (sig.log2FC > 0).sum() == 4637
+assert (sig.log2FC < 0).sum() == 2923
+assert W.shape == z.shape and (np.ptp(W, axis=1) > 0).mean() > .5
+chit1 = result.loc[result.gene_name.eq('CHIT1')].iloc[0]
+asah1 = result.loc[result.gene_name.eq('ASAH1')].iloc[0]
+assert np.isclose(chit1.log2FC, 3.505979, atol=1e-6)
+assert np.isclose(chit1.p, 1.584155e-10, rtol=1e-5)
+assert np.isclose(asah1.FDR, 9.850423e-22, rtol=1e-5)
+
+print('n', len(result), 'design', X.shape, 'rank', np.linalg.matrix_rank(a),
+      'sig/up/down', len(sig), (sig.log2FC > 0).sum(),
+      (sig.log2FC < 0).sum(), 'prior', prior)
+print('verification: DEG counts and CHIT1/ASAH1 statistics passed; W shape',
+      W.shape, 'sample-varying genes', int((np.ptp(W, axis=1) > 0).sum()))
+print('POS\n', sig.nlargest(20, 'log2FC').to_string(index=False))
+print('NEG\n', sig.nsmallest(20, 'log2FC').to_string(index=False))
+print('FDR\n', sig.nsmallest(20, 'FDR').to_string(index=False))
